description: This file defines a service class `EmployeeWorkExperienceService` in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing employee work experience data. It includes a dependency on a data access object `EmployeeWorkExperienceDao` and provides a getter method to retrieve or instantiate this DAO.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceService
classes.description: A service class that encapsulates business logic related to employee work experiences, managing access to the corresponding DAO.
